pp2.2:1.3: Yo kodho, kujjhanā, kujjhitattaṃ, doso, dussanā, dussitattaṃ, vyāpatti, vyāpajjanā, virodho, paṭivirodho, caṇḍittaṃ, asuropo, anattamanatā cittassa
pp2.2:2.4: Yo evarūpo upanāho, upanayhanā, upanayhitattaṃ, āṭhapanā, ṭhapanā, saṇṭhapanā, anupasaṇṭhapanā, anupabandhanā, daḷhikammaṃ kodhassa
pp2.2:3.3: Yo makkho, makkhāyanā, makkhāyitattaṃ, niddhunīyaṃ niddhunīyakammaṃ
pp2.2:4.3: Yo paḷāso, paḷāsāyanā, paḷāsāyitattaṃ, paḷāsākāro, vivādaṭṭhānaṃ, yuddhaggāho, apaṭinissaggo
pp2.2:5.3: Yā paralābha-sakkāra-garukāra-mānana-vandana-pūjanāsu issāyanā, issāyitattaṃ, ussuyā, ussuyanā, ussuyitattaṃ,
pp2.2:6.5: Yaṃ evarūpaṃ macchariyaṃ maccharāyanā, maccharāyitattaṃ, vevicchaṃ, kadariyaṃ, kaṭukañcukatā, aggahitattaṃ cittassa
pp2.2:7.4: Yaṃ tattha saṭhaṃ, saṭhatā, sāṭheyyaṃ, kakkaratā, kakkariyaṃ, parikkhatatā, parikkhattiyaṃ,
pp2.2:8.3: Idh' ekacco kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā, manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā, tassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpakaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati,
pp2.2:8.4: mā maṃ jaññā ti icchati mā maṃ jaññā ti saṅkappeti mā maṃ jaññā ti vācaṃ bhāsati mā maṃ jaññā ti kāyena parakkamati:
pp2.2:8.5: ya evarūpā māyā, māyāvitā, acchādanā, vañcanā, nikatī, nikaraṇā, pariharamā, gūhanā, parigūhanā, chādanā, paricchādanā, anuttānikammaṃ, anāvikammaṃ, vicchādanā, pāpakiriyā
pp2.2:9.3: Yaṃ na hiriyati hiriyitabbena na hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
pp2.2:10.3: Yaṃ na ottappati ottappitabbena na ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
pp2.2:11.3: Sahadhammike vuccamāne dovacassāyaṃ dovacassiyaṃ dovacassatā vippaṭikūlagāhitā vipaccanīkasātatā anādariyaṃ anādariyatā agāravatā appaṭissavatā
pp2.2:12.3: Ye te puggalā assaddhā dussīlā appassutā maccharino duppaññā, yā tesaṃ sevanā nisevanā saṃsevanā bhajanā sambhajanā bhatti sambhatti sampavaṅkatā
pp2.2:13.3: Idh' ekacco puggalo cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anuvyañjanaggāhī
pp2.2:13.4: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ: tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati;
pp2.2:13.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya nimittaggāhī hoti anuvyañjanaggāhī
pp2.2:13.10: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati na rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
pp2.2:13.11: Yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ agutti agopanā anārakkho asaṃvaro
pp2.2:13.13: Imāya indriyesu aguttadvāratāya samannāgato puggalo indriyesu aguttadvāro.
pp2.2:14.3: Idh' ekacco appaṭisaṅkhā ayoniso āhāram āhāreti davāyā, madāya, maṇḍanāya, vibhūsanāya, yā tattha asantuṭṭhitā amattaññutā appaṭisaṅkhā bhojane
pp2.2:14.5: Imāya bhojane amattaññutāya samannāgato puggalo bhojane amattaññū. 8.
pp2.2:15.3: Yā asati ananussati, appaṭissati, asaraṇatā, adhāraṇatā, vilāpanatā, sammussanatā,
pp2.2:16.3: Yam aññāṇaṃ, adassanaṃ, anabhisamayo, ananubodho, asambodho, appaṭivedho, asaṅgāhanā, apariyogāhanā, asamavekkhanā, apaccavekkhanā, apaccavekkhakammaṃ, dummejjhaṃ, bālyaṃ, asampajāññaṃ, moho, pamoho sammoho, avijjā, avijjogho, avijjāyogo, avijjānusayo, avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ, avijjālaṅgī, moho, akusalamūlam,
pp2.2:17.3: Kāyiko vītikkamo, vācasiko vītikkamo, kāyikavācasiko vītikkamo,
pp2.2:17.5: sabbam pi dussīlyaṃ sīlavippatti. Imāya sīlavipatti:
pp2.2:18.3: N' atthi dinnaṃ, n' atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, n' atthi hutaṃ, n' atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, n' atthi ayaṃ loko, n' atthi paraloko, n' atthi mātā, n' atthi pitā, n' atthi sattā opapātikā, n' atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā samaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañ ca lokaṃ parāñ ca lokaṃ sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī ti;
pp2.2:18.4: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi, diṭṭhigataṃ, diṭṭhigahaṇaṃ, diṭṭhikantāro, diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ, diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ, gāho, paṭiggāho, abhiniveso, parāmāso, kummaggo, micchāpatho, micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ, vipariyesaggāho, ayaṃ vuccati diṭṭhivipatti.
pp2.2:19.2: Yassa puggalassa pañc' orambhāgiyāni saññojanāni appahīnāni
pp2.2:20.2: Yassa puggalassa pañc' uddhambhāgiyāni saññojanāni appahīnāni
pp2.2:23.3: Yo makkho, makkhāyanā, makkhāyitattaṃ, niddhunīyaṃ niddhunīyakammaṃ,
pp2.2:25.3: Yā paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu issāyanā, issāyitattaṃ, ussuyā, ussuyanā, ussuyitattaṃ,
pp2.2:26.5: yaṃ evarūpaṃ macchariyaṃ, maccharāyanā, maccharāyitattaṃ, vevicchaṃ, kadariyaṃ, kaṭukañcukatā, aggahitattaṃ cittassa,
pp2.2:27.3: Idh' ekacco puggalo saṭho hoti parisaṭho;
pp2.2:27.4: yaṃ tattha saṭhaṃ saṭhatā, sāṭheyyaṃ, kakkaratā, kakkariyaṃ, parikkhatatā, parikkhattiyaṃ,
pp2.2:28.3: Idh' ekacca puggalo kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā, tassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpakaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati,
pp2.2:28.4: mā maṃ jaññā ti icchati, mā maṃ jaññā ti saṅkappeti, mā maṃ jaññā ti vācaṃ bhāsati, mā maṃ jaññā ti kāyena parakkamati
pp2.2:28.5: yā evarūpā māyā, māyāvitā, acchādanā, vañcanā, nikatī, nikaraṇā, pariharaṇā, gūhanā, parigūhanā, chādanā, paricchādanā, anuttānikammaṃ, anāvikammaṃ, vicchādanā, pāpakiriyā,
pp2.2:29.3: Yaṃ hiriyati hiriyitabbena hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā,
pp2.2:30.3: Yam ottappati ottappitabbena ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā,
pp2.2:31.3: Sahadhammike vuccamāne sovacassāyaṃ sovacassiyaṃ sovacassatā appaṭikūlagāhitā avipaccanīkasātatā sādariyaṃ sādariyatā sagāravatā sappaṭissavatā,
pp2.2:32.3: Ye te puggalā saddhā, sīlavanto, bahussutā, cāgavanto, paññavanto, yā tesaṃ sevanā. nisevanā, saṃsevanā, bhajanā, saṃbhajanā, bhatti, sampavaṅkatā,
pp2.2:33.3: Idh' ekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī
pp2.2:33.4: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ: tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatirakkhati cakkhunindriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaram āpajjati;
pp2.2:33.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī
pp2.2:33.10: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjādomanassā pāpakā akussalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
pp2.2:33.11: Yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ gutti, gopanā, ārakkho, saṃvaro
pp2.2:33.13: Imāya indriyesu guttadvāratāya samannāgato puggalo indriyesu guttadvāro.
pp2.2:34.3: Idh' ekacco paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
pp2.2:34.4: n' eva davāya, na madāya, na maṇḍanāya, na vibhūsanāya,
pp2.2:34.5: yāvad eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā, yāpanāya, vihiṃsūparatiyā, brahmacariyānuggahāya
pp2.2:34.6: iti purāṇañ ca vedanaṃ paṭisaṅkhāmi, navañ ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yatrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
pp2.2:34.7: Yā tattha santuṭṭhitā mattaññutā paṭisaṅkhā bhojane
pp2.2:34.9: Imāya bhojane mattaññutāya samannāgato puggalo bhojane mattaññūtā. 18.
pp2.2:35.3: Yā sati anussati, paṭissati, saraṇatā, dhāraṇatā, apilāpanatā, asammussanatā, sati, satindriyaṃ, satibalaṃ, sammāsati,
pp2.2:36.3: Yā paññā pajānanā, vicayo, pavicayo, dhammavicayo, sallakkhaṇā, upalakkhaṇā, paccupalakkhaṇā, paṇḍiccaṃ, kosallaṃ, nepuññaṃ, vebhavyā, cintā, upaparikkhā, bhūrī, medhā pariṇāyikā, vipassanā, sampajaññaṃ, patado, paññā, paññindrivaṃ, paññā-balaṃ, paññā-satthaṃ, paññā-pāsādo, paññā-āloko, paññā-obhāso, paññā-pajjoto, paññā-ratanaṃ, amoho, dhammavicayo, sammādiṭṭhi,
pp2.2:37.3: Kāyiko avītikkamo, vācasiko avītikkamo, kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo,
pp2.2:38.3: Atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko, atthi paraloko, atthi mātā, atthi pitā, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā samaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañ ca lokaṃ parañ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī ti:
pp2.2:38.4: yā evarūpā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . [II.18] amoho, dhammavicayo, sammādiṭṭhi,
pp2.2:39.2: Yo ca pubbakārī yo ca kataññukatavedī
pp2.2:40.2: Yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ nikkhipati yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ visajjeti
pp2.2:41.2: Yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ na nikkhipati yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ na vissajjeti
pp2.2:42.2: Yo ca na kukkuccāyitabbaṃ kukkuccāyati yo ca kukkuccāyitabbaṃ na kukkuccāyati,
pp2.2:43.1: Katamesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ āsavā na vaḍḍhanti?
pp2.2:43.2: Yo ca na kukkuccāyitabbaṃ na kukkuccāyati yo ca kukkuccāyitabbaṃ kukkuccāyati,
pp2.2:43.3: imesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ āsavā na vaḍḍhanti. 25.
pp2.2:44.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo, so aññaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ sevati bhajati payirupāsati:
pp2.2:45.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo so aññaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ sevati bhajati payirupāsati:
pp2.2:46.2: Paccekasambuddhā ye ca Tathāgatassa sāvakā arahanto tittā:
